Package de.juniorjacki.remotebrick.types

Class Animation

java.lang.Object
de.juniorjacki.remotebrick.types.Animation
public class Animation extends Object
Represents a 5x5 pixel animation for Inventor Hub display.

Animations are composed of individual frames, where each frame is a 5x5 grid of brightness values. Each pixel is represented by a digit from 0 (off) to 9 (full brightness). Frames are stored as strings in the format: "12345:00000:54321:00000:12345".

Display Specifications (Inventor Hub):

  • Resolution: 5x5 monochrome LED matrix
  • Brightness Levels: 0–9 (10 levels, 0 = off, 9 = max)
  • Frame Format: 5 rows × 5 columns, separated by colons (:)
  • Max Frames: No strict limit (practical: ≤100 for smooth playback)
  • Playback: Controlled via hub commands (not part of this class)

Use addFrame(String) for raw frame strings or addImage(Image) for pre-built images.

Example Frame (smiley):

 "09090:90009:00000:90009:09990"

  • Method Details

    • addImage

      public Animation addImage(Image image)
      Adds a pre-defined Image as a frame to the animation.

      The image is converted to its 5x5 string representation before being added.

      Parameters:
      image - The Image to add as a frame. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      This Animation instance for method chaining.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if image is null.

    • addFrame

      public Animation addFrame(String frameData)
      Adds a raw frame string to the animation.

      The frame must be exactly 5x5 and contain only digits 0–9. Example valid frame: "00000:00100:01110:00100:00000"

      Parameters:
      frameData - The 5x5 frame as a string with colons separating rows.
      Returns:
      This Animation instance for method chaining.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the frame format is invalid.
      NullPointerException - if frameData is null.
      See Also:
      • validateFrame(String)
